FIELDS.NAME: Cellular Solutions Inc.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cellular Solutions Inc. specializes in the retail sale and service of cellular phones, accessories, and related technology solutions. Our operations encompass a wide range of services including device sales, repair services such as screen replacements and battery swaps, and activation of mobile plans. We source our inventory directly from authorized manufacturers and reputable distributors to ensure quality and authenticity. Our trained staff is committed to providing excellent customer service, guiding clients in selecting the right devices and plans to meet their needs. We maintain robust cybersecurity measures to protect customer data and implement strict inventory management protocols to minimize theft and loss. Our commitment to transparency extends to clear warranty and repair policies, ensuring customers are well-informed of their options and protections. Our physical store operates during regular business hours, supplemented by an online sales platform featuring secure payment processing. We prioritize compliance with relevant data protection regulations to safeguard customer information and uphold our service commitments.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 11/15/2022; Cause: Theft of 10 smartphones from the store; Amount: $1,200.00; Status: Resolved
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Security Rating: Grade A, UL-Listed Safe (Fire and Burglary), 1-Hour Fire Resistance, 200 lbs.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security system with 24/7 monitoring and access control measures.
